business_problem: HP needed to analyze device and application telemetry across millions of endpoints so IT teams could identify digital friction early and proactively improve workforce productivity.
solution_summary: HP Inc. uses Amazon S3, Amazon Redshift, and Amazon Kinesis to support digital employee experience analytics and remediation. HP needed to analyze device and application telemetry across millions of endpoints so IT teams could identify digital friction early and proactively improve workforce productivity. In practice, the implementation ingests source data through Amazon Kinesis, and stores or organizes core datasets in Amazon S3. Workflow, ticket, and platform telemetry are consolidated into Amazon S3. The case study reports PB+ of digital interaction dataanalyzed per day 3 and million digital friction remediations conducted per month 4.6, showing measurable improvement after the rollout.
